title: Trump touts newly built WH helipad and renovations
text:
South Lawn of White House with newly built helipad. (Image via President Donald Trump’s Truth Social) OAN Staff Addie Davis
2:00 PM – Thursday, October 15, 2026
President Donald Trump touted the newly built helipad on the South Lawn of the White House, as well as other renovations made to the presidential residence under his tenure.
Late Wednesday night, Trump posted images on social media showcasing the restored helipad — complete with the presidential seal and the White House’s south facade — emphasizing that the project has added “decades of additional life” to the historic complex.
“Actual pictures of our fully renovated White House façade, facing South, with the new South Entrance, and Heliport! Over the years, the façade, both North and South, suffered tremendous wear, tear, and damage,” he said.
“The exterior walls and ornamentation, both missing and in bad condition, has been fully restored to the Highest Level, giving the White House many decades of additional life! It had to be done, and I am very proud to be the President who did it!” he continued.
Trump also pointed to the White House ballroom currently under construction, framing it as a secure venue for large-scale events.
“Likewise, the Ballroom and Military Complex, is on time, and on budget, and will make an unbelievably beautiful addition, the first since the West Wing in 1901, to the White House,” he added.
